import json,pathlib,hashlib,base64,zlib,struct,time
from fractions import Fraction as F
t=time.perf_counter();root=pathlib.Path('.')
r=json.loads((root/'coordinacion/respuestas/AXIAL-SELECTOR-INT256-001-CODEX.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
run=r['run'];raw=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(run['stdout_zlib_base64'],validate=True))
assert len(raw)==run['stdout_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==run['stdout_sha256'] and run['rc']==0
a=json.loads(raw);S=2**149;MIN=-2**255;MAX=2**255-1
def integer(w):
 assert isinstance(w,list) and len(w)==8 and all(type(v) is int and 0<=v<2**32 for v in w)
 n=sum(v*2**(32*i) for i,v in enumerate(w))
 return n-2**256 if n>=2**255 else n
def float32(w):
 assert type(w) is int and 0<=w<2**32
 e=(w>>23)&255;m=w&0x7fffff
 assert e!=255 and not(e==0 and m)
 return F(*struct.unpack('<f',struct.pack('<I',w))[0].as_integer_ratio())
nodes=0
def verify(s):
 global nodes
 ws=s['quotient_uint32'];x=sum(map(float32,ws),F(0));radius=F(integer(s['radius_signed256_words']),S)
 assert radius>=0 and F(integer(s['observed_cycles_signed256_words']),S)==x
 ends=[x-radius,x,x+radius]
 assert [F(integer(v),S) for v in s['enclosure_signed256_words']]==[ends[0],ends[2]]
 ns=[(v+F(1,2))//1 for v in ends];ks=[(4*(v-ns[1])+F(1,2))//1 for v in ends]
 accepted=len(set(ns))==1 and len(set(ks))==1
 assert accepted==s['accepted_CPU_integer_selector_only']
 assert not(s['GPU_executed'] or s['ALU_executed'] or s['accepted_full_field_pipeline'] or s['native_selector_implemented'])
 expected=[]
 def node(label,op,x,y,v):expected.append((label,op,x,y,v));return v
 X=int(x*S);R=int(radius*S)
 node('decode.sum','add',int(float32(ws[0])*S),int(float32(ws[1])*S),X)
 lo=node('enclosure.lo','sub',X,R,X-R);hi=node('enclosure.hi','add',X,R,X+R)
 for tag,v,n in zip(['lo','observed','hi'],[lo,X,hi],ns):
  z=node(tag+'.turn.offset','add',v,2**148,v+2**148)
  node(tag+'.turn.shift','shr',z,149,n)
 if len(set(ns))==1:
  center=node('turn.center','shl',ns[1],149,ns[1]*S)
  rs=[node(tag+'.centered','sub',v,center,v-center) for tag,v in zip(['lo','observed','hi'],[lo,X,hi])]
  for tag,v,k in zip(['lo','observed','hi'],rs,ks):
   z=node(tag+'.quarter.offset','add',v,2**146,v+2**146)
   node(tag+'.quarter.shift','shr',z,147,k)
  if accepted:
   q=node('quarter.center','shl',ks[1],147,ks[1]*2**147)
   res=node('residual','sub',rs[1],q,rs[1]-q)
   assert F(res,S)==x-ns[1]-F(ks[1],4) and abs(res)<=2**146
   assert s['integer_turn']==ns[1] and s['quarter_index']==ks[1] and s['quarter_mod4']==ks[1]%4
   assert s['residual_scale_exponent']==-149 and integer(s['residual_cycles_signed256_words'])==res
 assert len(expected)==len(s['operations'])==s['integer_operations']
 for e,n in zip(expected,s['operations']):
  label,op,x,y,z=e
  assert n['label']==label and n['op']==op and list(map(integer,n['inputs_signed256_words']))==[x,y] and integer(n['output_signed256_words'])==z
  assert all(MIN<=v<=MAX for v in (x,y,z))
  nodes+=1
prevf='coordinacion/respuestas/AXIAL-REDUCTION-DETECTOR-RN64-001-CODEX.json'
assert hashlib.sha256((root/prevf).read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='0ee74281cfb6bd775da4c1d72b58ecc712e534976850eafe673d450e805b503d'
prev=json.loads((root/prevf).read_bytes())
for f,h in prev['code_doc_sha256'].items():assert hashlib.sha256((root/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,f
assert a['audit']['pins_verified']==prev['code_doc_sha256']
def old(f):
 b=json.loads((root/('coordinacion/respuestas/'+f+'-CODEX.json')).read_bytes());c=b['run'];v=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(c['stdout_zlib_base64'],validate=True))
 assert hashlib.sha256(v).hexdigest()==c['stdout_sha256'] and len(v)==c['stdout_bytes']
 return json.loads(v)['audit']['cases']
olds=old('AXIAL-PHASE-QUOTIENT-001');units=old('AXIAL-UNIT-ROTATION-001')
assert set(a['audit']['cases'])==set(olds) and len(olds)==18
paths=partial=full=0
for name,c in a['audit']['cases'].items():
 p=olds[name];u=units[name]
 for key in ['original_scene_binding_sha256','decoded_scene_binding_sha256']:
  assert c[key]==p[key]==u[key]
 assert c['previous_full_case_accepted']==p['previous_full_case_accepted'] and not c['accepted_full_field_pipeline']
 assert c['previous_phase_argument_accepted']==p['accepted_phase_argument_CPU_only']
 full+=c['previous_full_case_accepted']
 assert len(c['paths'])==len(p['paths'])==len(u['paths'])
 flags=[]
 for new,oldpath,oldunit in zip(c['paths'],p['paths'],u['paths']):
  assert new['source_id']==oldpath['source_id']==oldunit['source_id']
  assert new['phase_reference_id']==oldpath['phase_reference_id']==oldunit['phase_reference_id']
  assert new['previous_phase_argument_accepted']==oldpath['accepted_phase_argument_CPU_only']
  assert new['previous_unit_accepted']==oldunit['accepted_propagation_unit_CPU_only']
  assert new['integer_selector_evaluated']==oldpath['accepted_phase_argument_CPU_only']
  if not new['integer_selector_evaluated']:
   assert 'selector' not in new;flags.append(False);continue
  paths+=1;s=new['selector'];verify(s);flags.append(s['accepted_CPU_integer_selector_only'])
  oldsel=oldpath['selector'];n=oldsel['CPU_integer_turn'];x=F(*oldsel['centered_observed_cycles_rational'])+n
  lo,hi=[F(*v)+n for v in oldsel['centered_enclosure_cycles_rational']]
  exact=max(x-lo,hi-x);q=exact*S;ceil=(q.numerator+q.denominator-1)//q.denominator
  h=new['host_radius'];assert F(*h['exact_radius_cycles_rational'])==exact
  assert integer(h['radius_signed256_words'])==ceil==integer(s['radius_signed256_words'])
  inf=F(*h['outward_inflation_cycles_rational']);assert inf==F(ceil,S)-exact and 0<=inf<F(1,S)
  assert F(integer(s['observed_cycles_signed256_words']),S)==x
  assert F(integer(s['enclosure_signed256_words'][0]),S)<=lo<=hi<=F(integer(s['enclosure_signed256_words'][1]),S)
  assert s['quotient_uint32']==oldpath['measurement']['quotient_limb_uint32']
  if s['accepted_CPU_integer_selector_only']:
   assert s['integer_turn']==n and s['quarter_index']==oldunit['quarter_CPU_index']
   assert F(integer(s['residual_cycles_signed256_words']),S)==F(*oldunit['quarter_residual_cycles_rational'])
 assert c['accepted_integer_selector_CPU_only']==all(flags)
 partial+=c['accepted_integer_selector_CPU_only']
for s in a['primitives'].values():verify(s)
assert a['independent_oracle_checks']==96
assert not a['primitives']['asymmetric_symmetrized_reject']['accepted_CPU_integer_selector_only']
assert a['primitives']['domain_min']['integer_turn']==-2**106
assert full==8 and partial==17 and paths==21
print(json.dumps(dict(validated=True,retained_cases=18,retained_paths=paths,partial_selector_pass=partial,previous_fullcase_accepted=full,previous_FAIL=18-full,full_field_promotions=0,pins=69,integer_nodes_verified=nodes,retained_integer_nodes=paths*21,primitive_cases=len(a['primitives']),independent_oracle_checks=96,raw_sha256=run['stdout_sha256'],elapsed_s=time.perf_counter()-t)))
